arguments.command:
python -c "
from glom import Auto, Fill, Iter, Let, ROOT, Invoke, constants, consts
import warnings

# Test that all names are accessible
print('Auto:', Auto)
print('Fill:', Fill)
print('Iter:', Iter)
print('Let:', Let)
print('ROOT:', ROOT)
print('Invoke:', Invoke)
print('constants:', constants)

# Test deprecation warning for consts
with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
    warnings.simplefilter('always')
    print('consts:', consts)
    if w:
        print('Deprecation warning caught:', str(w[0].message))
"
